Exercise 1: Create a training Dockerfile

[!NOTE] Learning outcomes By the end of the exercises, we expect you to be able to do the following:

  • Write/create a basic Dockerfile that can run a basic DS project [e.g., CCDS]
  • Explain the workflow and processes for using Docker
  • Motivate the typical ways why you would modify Docker containers at runtime
  • Describe image repositories and explain their usage
  1. Build out our CCDS repo with a train.py script Go to where you have your projects and run ccds. You can also initialise git with git init.

    To make it easy, there is a ../resources/train.py that you can copy to your project. So for example:

    cp ../resources/train.py path/to/project/modeling/train.py
  2. Create train.dockerfile You can use your favourite tool to do this. Or do:
    touch path/to/project/train.dockerfile
  3. Find appropiate base-image python:3.9 for example.
  4. Modify example Dockerfile to fit our use-case Inspired from this website:
    
FROM python:3.12
WORKDIR /usr/local/app
# Install the application dependencies
COPY requirements.txt ./
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
# Copy in the source code
COPY src ./src
EXPOSE 5000
# Setup an app user so the container doesn't run as the root user
RUN useradd app
USER app
CMD ["uvicorn", "app.main:app", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8080"]

Next: Exercise 2 - Build the Image
